latestVersion.changelog:
Game Music — Add Music to Game Videos v1.0.0

- Initial release: instantly add AI-generated background music to video game footage with simple text instructions.
- Supports 2-minute gameplay recordings, automatic 1080p rendering, and quick cloud processing (30–60 seconds).
- No manual timeline editing or complicated export steps; everything handled via chat prompts.
- Automatic connection to cloud backend with free credits for new users.
- Full support for credit checks, status reports, timeline previews, and multi-format exports (mp4, mov, avi, mp3, etc).
- Handles common errors and guides users through upload, editing, and export workflows.
